detail: Probe (scratchpad gitignore-probe.mjs against a tsc build of HEAD 3543dc6, Node 25.8.1): FILES backend — after removing decisions/index.json, graph/entities.json, graph/relations.json but keeping decisions/<id>.json: get(id) OK; getByScope/getIndex THROW ENOENT (readJSON rethrows non-SyntaxError); create/updateStatus THROW ENOENT from proper-lockfile lstat on the missing index; getEntities/getRelations return [] and the first addEntity recreates empty graph files (private divergent graph, new ULIDs). repairIndexDesync(true) reported orphan_ids=[id], repaired=1, after which getByScope and create work. SQLITE backend — the scaffold writes the three v1 files as [] and the sqlite write path never touches them (still [] after decision+entity+relation writes; no decisions/<id>.json legacy file written); after deleting the three files and twining.db* but keeping records/, resolveAutoBackend → sqlite/sqlite-state, createStores → legacy_unread=false, records_unread=false, getByScope returns the decision, entities=2, relations=1, create works, and the three files are NOT recreated. Context: Dave asked whether a project gitignoring those three files would have issues; answer branches on backend.
summary: Verified: FILES backend clone missing decisions/index.json throws ENOENT on every index read AND on create/updateStatus; repair_index rebuilds it losslessly. On SQLITE the three v1 files are inert.
